name: phantom-plugins
description: Plugins for Phantom IDEA, installed on demand instead of bundled

plugins.name: Phantom Database Console
plugins.description: Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL or H2 over JDBC and run SQL from the editor: highlighting, Ctrl+Enter to run the statement at the caret, a sortable result grid and a lazily loaded schema tree. Drivers come from the project's dependencies or the local Gradle/Maven cache. Manual-commit data sources keep changes in an open transaction you review, commit or roll back in the Database Changes tool window. Edit single-table results in the grid, and compare two schemas with the SQL to make them match. SQL in @Query(nativeQuery = true), @NativeQuery and JdbcTemplate/JdbcClient strings is highlighted and completed. Query history (Ctrl+Alt+E), result export to CSV, TSV, JSON, SQL INSERT or Markdown, and JPA entity generation from a table. 0.5.0: SQL that understands names (alias-aware completion with schema loaded on demand, Ctrl+B to the table or column, unknown table/column warnings, Reformat), a table data view with WHERE/ORDER BY filters, paging and foreign-key navigation, keys/foreign keys/indexes/routines/triggers in the tree, Show DDL and Modify Table, manual-commit transactions, Explain Plan/Analyze and query parameters. 0.6.0: 18 SQL inspections, each toggleable (UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, JOIN without ON, unused CTE, alias problems, VALUES count, UNION column count, GROUP BY, CASE vs COALESCE, and with the schema loaded: ambiguous columns, NOT NULL columns, string length, type mismatch). Wave 6: 12 more SQL checks (= NULL, constant conditions, aggregates in WHERE, redundant COALESCE/LIMIT, unused subquery columns, duplicate columns, ADD NOT NULL without default, deprecated MySQL types, USING columns, ORDER BY position). Wave 7: duplicate AUTO_INCREMENT, MySQL function-name space, insert into generated columns, misleading subquery references. Wave 8: JPA entities checked against the real schema (unknown tables/columns, optional nullability) and @Table/@Column name completion from the database.

plugins.name: Phantom Spring
plugins.description: Spring support for Java and Kotlin: bean injection navigation in both directions, an autowiring inspection, correct unused analysis for Spring-managed code, Spring MVC handlers for the Endpoints tool window, Spring Security path and expression support, and Kafka/RabbitMQ/JMS sender-receiver navigation. 0.4.0: proxy pitfalls (self-invocation of @Transactional/@Cacheable/@Async, private/final/static proxied methods, Kotlin classes not opened by kotlin-spring), @Scheduled/@Async/@EventListener contracts, field and static injection, duplicate bean names, @Scope values, @Sql paths, @DirtiesContext, publishEvent ↔ listener gutters, @Qualifier/@DependsOn bean name completion and Ctrl+B. Wave 6: @Value placeholders (follows spring.config.import), SpEL syntax, cache names, caching on interfaces, @Qualifier/@DependsOn near-miss names, MVC path variables, endpoint and AOP advice gutters, method security not enabled, pointcut syntax. Wave 7: @Cacheable+@CachePut, abstract beans, @Value literal types, @Bean method shape, scan packages, AspectJ autoproxy, @Autowired outside beans, resource locations, @TestBean factories, @Around/pointcut/argNames/@DeclareParents, Security debug/self-invocation/bean refs. Wave 8: @Bean init/destroy methods, @Lookup, Resource @Value, @Profile expressions and unknown profiles, bean name convention, argNames bindings; cache, @Scheduled and @Import gutters.

plugins.name: Phantom Spring Boot
plugins.description: Spring Boot support: File → New → Project → Spring Boot generates projects with Spring Initializr, and application*.yml / application*.properties get completion and quick documentation for keys and values, from library metadata and the project's own @ConfigurationProperties, in Java and Kotlin. An Actuator tab beside the console of a running app (health, beans, mappings, environment, polled only while shown; only for modules with spring-boot-starter-actuator), and completion and Ctrl+B for ${...} placeholders in @Value from the project's application.yml/properties and Spring Boot metadata. Wave 7: datasource driver missing, config key <-> @Value/@ConfigurationProperties gutters, spring.config.import files count as config. Wave 8: profile override gutters between application-<profile> and base config, @SpringBootApplication -> config files.

plugins.name: Phantom JPA
plugins.description: JPA, Hibernate and Spring Data JPA for Java and Kotlin: JPQL in @Query with completion and errors, derived query method checks, a @Modifying check, entity mapping checks, and repository/entity gutter navigation. An Entity Diagram tool window: entities, columns and relations drawn from the code, copyable as a Mermaid erDiagram. 0.3.0: entity checks (several @Id, no-arg constructor, mappedBy, raw collections, converters), attribute checks (@Column on associations, LAZY on the inverse @OneToOne, @ManyToMany cascade REMOVE, unmapped entity fields, @Enumerated), Kotlin entity checks (kotlin-jpa/all-open, data class, val attributes, read-only collections), Lombok on entities, repository return and parameter types and Pageable. Wave 6: JPQL undeclared aliases and function arity, entity graph attributes, entity listener callback signatures. Wave 7: entity listener usage, named queries, JPQL in createQuery, Kotlin non-null vs nullable columns, Lombok @AllArgsConstructor without no-arg.

plugins.name: Phantom Reactive Streams
plugins.description: Reactor and RxJava checks for Java and Kotlin: a Mono, Flux or RxJava source created and dropped without being subscribed, and blocking calls inside reactive operators.

plugins.name: Phantom Ktor
plugins.description: Ktor server routes from the routing DSL, including routes in Route extension functions with the prefixes of their callers, in the Endpoints tool window.

plugins.name: Phantom Kubernetes
plugins.description: Helm chart templates: .Values completion and navigation from values.yaml, .Release/.Chart fields, include/define navigation, and a warning for values that values.yaml does not define. 0.2.0: manifest checks for built-in kinds (removed API versions, unknown and missing keys with key completion, duplicate env vars, selector/template label mismatch); YAML in Markdown fences is skipped. Wave 7: unknown kinds, enum values, deprecated keys/resources, server-set fields, Chart.yaml. Wave 8: gutters Service <-> workloads, ConfigMap/Secret/ServiceAccount references, Ingress backends.

plugins.name: Phantom Profiler
plugins.description: CPU and allocation profiling for Java and Kotlin with Java Flight Recorder: a Profile action next to Run and Debug, a Profiler tool window that records any running JVM, and a .jfr viewer with flame graph, call tree, hot methods, allocations and GC summary. Profile also works on Gradle run configurations: tests run by Gradle and applications delegated to Gradle, one recording per forked JVM.

plugins.name: Phantom Docker
plugins.description: Docker Compose through the docker CLI: run icons on compose services, a Docker Compose run configuration shown in Services, and a Docker tool window listing containers by compose project with start, stop, restart, remove, logs and compose down. Polls only while open. 0.2.0: Compose checks (unknown keys and values, undefined services/networks/volumes with Ctrl+B and completion, missing image, unquoted base-60 ports, duplicate container names) and Dockerfile checks (continuations, argument counts, exec form, heredocs, stages, COPY/ADD paths). Wave 7: Compose pull_policy and network_mode values. Wave 8: Compose build -> Dockerfile and depends_on gutters, Dockerfile stage Ctrl+B.

plugins.name: Phantom Redis
plugins.description: A Redis browser and console: keys by SCAN pattern, values of every type with JSON indented, delete, and a redis-cli style command line with history. Password, ACL user, database and TLS. Connects only while the Redis tool window is shown.

plugins.name: Phantom Kafka
plugins.description: A Kafka browser: topics with partitions and offsets, latest/earliest/since-time messages read without joining a group, sending with key, headers and partition, consumer group lag, create and delete topics. SASL/SSL via client properties in the password safe.

plugins.name: Phantom Bean Validation
plugins.description: Bean Validation checks for Java and Kotlin: contradictory bounds (@Min above @Max, @Size min above max), constraints on types they cannot validate, Kotlin constructor properties whose constraint lands on the parameter (quick fix: @field:), nested objects with constraints but no @Valid, and Spring beans with method constraints but no @Validated. Wave 7: custom @Constraint definitions.

plugins.name: Phantom Migrations
plugins.description: Flyway and Liquibase checks: migration names Flyway skips (single underscore, lower-case prefix, no description) and duplicate versions in db/migration and spring.flyway.locations; duplicate changeset id and author and missing include/includeAll paths in XML, YAML and formatted SQL changelogs. Wave 8: Flyway previous/next migration gutters, Liquibase include navigation.

plugins.name: Phantom OpenAPI
plugins.description: OpenAPI and Swagger specs in YAML and JSON: $ref navigation to local pointers and other files, #/components/... completion, unresolved $ref errors, and gutter links between a spec operation and its handler (Spring MVC and any framework in the Endpoints view).

plugins.name: Phantom HTTP Client
plugins.description: HTTP requests in .http / .rest files, run from the editor: file and http-client.env.json environment variables, import and run lines to reuse requests from other files, a run gutter per request plus Run All, checks for common mistakes (broken JSON bodies, headers the client can't send, unknown methods, missing ###, broken {{}}, plain http to remote hosts), and a response view with status, headers and a formatted body. Moved out of the Phantom core so it updates like any other plugin.
